color.$description: Primitive color ramps. Mode-agnostic. Engineers and LLMs do NOT consume these directly — use semantic aliases (color.surface.*, color.text.*, etc.) instead. Lumen v0.11 retunes brand to obsidian-mint (warm-cool near-black with a faint green undertone, anchored at #171A18) and rebuilds the accent as Spring Green #00FA8A. Premium-psychology release: fewer colors, used with confidence.

absolute.$description: v0.11.13 — Pure black + pure white. Reserved for components that must paint a colour-mode-invariant white or black (range-slider thumb, danger-CTA foreground, light-mode raised + popover surfaces). Use sparingly — most surfaces should reach for a semantic alias (color.surface.*, color.text.*) so light + dark themes can diverge.

white.$description: Pure paper. Appears as fixed value on tokens that don't theme-flip (range-slider thumb, danger-CTA fg).

black.$description: Pure ink. Reserved for sentinel use (rare). Most ink moments should reach color.brand.900/950 instead.

brand.$description: Obsidian-Mint — the canvas ladder. Anchored at #171A18 (brand.800). A neutral near-black with a faint green undertone (G channel +2 over R, +1 over B) so it reads cohesive against the spring-green accent without competing. Replaces the v0.4–v0.10 obsidian ramp. The dark-mode silhouette and the deep-ink moments in light mode.

50.$description: Cream-leaning paper for light theme — slight green tint

100.$description: Brand light anchor — the user-fixed light value. Used as subtle borders, sunken surfaces in light mode, and as primary text on dark.

200.$description: Mid-tone. Subtle borders, disabled text on light.

300.$description: Tertiary text on dark. Captions, hints.

400.$description: Secondary text on dark. AA-safe at 14px+.

600.$description: Popover surface, dark. v0.11.11 retune (was #2E3230) — mint tilt scaled from G+4 to G+3 so the canvas anchor is the only stop carrying visible undertone.

700.$description: Raised surface, dark — sits subtly above canvas with restrained mint tilt. v0.11.11 retune (was #21241F) — darker (lightness ~11% vs canvas 9.7%) and tilt scaled from G+5 to G+3 so panels read as 'a card on canvas' rather than 'a brighter green surface above canvas.'

800.$description: Canvas — DEFAULT dark. The user-fixed brand dark value.

950.$description: Void / deepest. Used only for hard-edge contrast moments.

accent.$description: Spring Green — the only loud color in the system. Anchored at #00FA8A (accent.500). Brighter and more electric than the v0.4–v0.10 lime; reads as 'laser' against obsidian-mint. Reserved for action / live / success. Never used decoratively. The single-accent discipline (ADR 0005) is preserved verbatim — only the hue changed.

50.$description: Tint background (rare). For accent-tinted card hovers in light mode.

300.$description: Laser-bright on dark — used for emphasis text, focus glow on obsidian.

400.$description: Just above brand value — dark-mode focus ring, hover lift on obsidian.

500.$description: BRAND VALUE — Spring Green. The canonical Lumen accent. Never softened.

800.$description: Accent text on light surfaces. ~4.6:1 on white — AA-safe at 14px+.

900.$description: Accent text in dense reading copy on light. AAA on white.

fg.$description: Near-black-mint text on accent surfaces. ~14.7:1 on accent.500 — AAA. Cohesive with brand.800.

neutral.$description: Cool-neutral grays — paper canvas + neutral text in light mode + warm-tinted accents on dark. Replaces the v0.4–v0.10 'warm' (cream) ramp. The brand is no longer warm; the system ships cool-neutral with a faint green undertone so all surfaces read cohesive against the spring-green accent. Anchored at #E6E6E6 (neutral.200) for surface alignment with brand.100.

50.$description: Page canvas — pure paper-white with whisper of warmth. Light mode default.

100.$description: Raised surface in light mode (rare — most surfaces stay on neutral.50 with hairlines).

200.$description: Subtle border / sunken surface. Matches user-fixed light brand value. Used for inputs at rest, table-row hover, sidebar.

300.$description: Default border on light. Hairlines, disabled outlines.

500.$description: Tertiary text on light. Hints, captions.

700.$description: Body text on light, deep secondary.

900.$description: Deepest ink — primary heading text. Distinct from brand.900 by a hair so the cool-warm tilt sings.

warm.$description: DEPRECATED v0.11 — backwards-compat alias to neutral.* for token consumers stuck on v0.10 paths. Will be removed in v1.0. New code uses color.neutral.*.
warm.$deprecated: Replaced by color.neutral.* in v0.11.0. Will be removed in v1.0.0. The v0.4–v0.10 warm-cream ramp was retired with the obsidian-mint brand shift; the system is no longer warm.

status.$description: Status palette. Always paired with a label or shape — never used as the sole signal. v0.11 refines danger and warning to feel less alert / more confident; saturation reduced ~6% from v0.10 to harmonize with the cooler obsidian-mint canvas. Success rides the accent ramp (single-accent rule). Info rides neutral + accent.

success.$description: Success rides the spring-green accent ramp — single-accent rule. Pre-bound here for status-component consumption.

warning.$description: Refined amber — slightly more golden, slightly less saturated than v0.10 (#f59e0b). Reads premium against obsidian-mint without competing with the spring green.

300.$description: v0.11.13 — soft warm-gold for warning text on the dark obsidian-mint canvas. ~9.1:1 — AAA. The semantic color.text.warning consumes this stop.

danger.$description: Refined deep red — desaturated 8% from v0.10 #ef4444 to feel less aggressive. Maintains AA contrast for danger CTAs.

300.$description: v0.11.13 — softened error text on the dark obsidian-mint canvas. ~6.5:1 — AA Normal. The semantic color.text.error and color.action.danger-soft.fg both consume this stop.

700.$description: Danger CTA bg.rest. AA Normal (5.4:1 white-on-bg).

info.$description: Info hue — neutral with accent-text. v0.4 dropped sky-blue (no second loud color); v0.11 keeps that decision and pulls info into the cool-neutral spectrum.

alpha.$description: Translucent overlays. Used for scrims, blurred chrome, ticker fades, and the accent ambient glow. Ink anchored to brand.800-equivalent (#171A18 → 0.04–0.86). Paper anchored to pure white. Accent anchored to spring-green #00FA8A. Void anchored to brand.950 (#060807) for the deepest scrim. Shadow anchored to a fixed neutral (#0E1219) — distinct from the obsidian-mint ramp so dark-mode shadows stay subtle but readable. Danger anchored to refined red.500 (#E5484D).

04.$description: v0.9 — outline-hover bg. Re-anchored to brand.800 in v0.11.

62.$description: v0.11.13 — dark-mode glass surface alpha. Pair with backdrop-filter blur(20px) saturate(140%).

72.$description: v0.11.13 — dark-mode glass-strong surface alpha. The dark glass-action hover stop.

84.$description: v0.11 — heavy ink scrim for high-contrast moments.

86.$description: v0.11.13 — dark-mode floating overlay alpha. The dark glass-action press stop.

04.$description: v0.9 — outline-hover bg in dark mode.

08.$description: v0.9 — ghost-press bg in dark mode.

10.$description: v0.9 — glass-rest border in dark mode.

16.$description: v0.9 — outline-rest border in dark mode.

24.$description: v0.9 — outline-hover border in dark mode.

60.$description: v0.11.13 — light-mode glass-shadow inset highlight (inner). Used by --shadow-inset on the light theme.

72.$description: Light-mode glass surface alpha. The action.glass.bg.rest stop in light mode.

80.$description: v0.11.13 — light-mode glass-shadow inset highlight (outer). Used by --shadow-glass top edge on the light theme.

void.$description: v0.11.13 — alphas anchored to brand.950 (#060807, the deepest stop on the obsidian-mint ramp). Reserved for surfaces that must read deeper than canvas — modal scrims in dark mode where canvas-anchored ink would visually merge with the dark canvas underneath.

72.$description: Dark-mode modal scrim. Reads ~18% darker than alpha.ink.72, which makes the floating modal content feel held above a darker plate.

shadow.$description: v0.11.13 — alphas anchored to a fixed neutral (#0E1219, RGB 14,18,25). Distinct from the obsidian-mint brand ramp because shadows want a steady neutral cast independent of brand-color shifts. Used by every shadow.* primitive. Pulled out of inline shadow declarations into this primitive family in v0.11.13 so the shadow color anchor is a single point of maintenance.

accent.$description: Spring-green alphas. Re-anchored to #00FA8A in v0.11. The accent-glow signature opacity (0.24) is preserved verbatim from the lime era — it reads with the same atmospheric weight on the new hue.

08.$description: Whisper tint — table-row hover, subtle accent surfaces.

12.$description: Subtle accent tint — card hover, selected state.

20.$description: v0.11.13 — primary-button glow active stop. Press collapse — narrower halo than rest.

24.$description: The signature accent-glow opacity — preserved from v0.4.

25.$description: v0.11.13 — primary-button glow rest stop. Soft and steady ambient halo.

40.$description: v0.4 — strong glow halo. Also the primary-button glow hover stop.

danger.$description: v0.6 — translucent error halos. Re-anchored to refined danger.500 #E5484D in v0.11. v0.11.13 added the 08/14/18 stops to back the danger-soft × ghost surface in light + dark.

warning.$description: v0.6 — translucent warning halos. Re-anchored to refined warning.500 #F5B118 in v0.11.
